name: Collective Resistance
oracle_text:
Escalate {G} (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target enchantment.
• Target creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Escalate {G} (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)

needs.what: a card-level additional cost for a modal spell (choose_mode with or_more) that charges the printed escalate cost once for each mode chosen beyond the first, with the modes (and their per-mode targets) chosen at cast time so the total cost is locked in during 601.2b-f
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_cost_keys has no escalate. spree prices each mode individually, so it would charge for the first mode too (whichever it is); additional_repeatable/multikicker lets the caster pay any number of times with no tie to how many modes were chosen; choose_mode's `budget` spends a resolution-time budget on mode prices rather than adding mana to the cast cost; a plain `or_more` choose_mode would let all three modes be chosen for {1}{G}, which is strictly better than the printed card
